data_mode: web path (ESPN + BBC cached pages); no player ratings, so best/worst are Scout's pick
headline: Atlético made 1.37 xG in the first half and 0.15 after it; Barcelona kept 63% of the ball and came from behind to win 2-1.

team_story.label: Possession %
team_story.why_it_matters: Barcelona kept the ball for most of the game, away from home.

team_story.label: Total passes
team_story.why_it_matters: Barcelona had 284 more passes; Atlético had 61 long balls to 33 but could not keep the ball.

team_story.label: Shots
team_story.why_it_matters: Barcelona doubled Atlético's shot count, but only 4 were on target for each side.

team_story.label: Shots (second half)
team_story.why_it_matters: After the break Atlético managed two shots, none on target, and Barcelona took ten.
team_story.source: derived.json (analysis.py) from shots_espn.json, ESPN shot map https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401882816/barcelona-atletico-madrid

team_story.label: xG (summed from shot map)
team_story.why_it_matters: Overall chance quality was close; the first-half/second-half split is the story.
team_story.source: derived.json: sum of per-shot xG in shots_espn.json (ESPN shot map)

half_split.source: derived.json (analysis.py) from shots_espn.json; 45'+N counted as first half

tactical_change.after: formation after the changes not stated by source
tactical_change.trigger: Half-time substitution: Frenkie de Jong on for Brian Fariñas (ESPN 45', BBC 46'); Andreas Christensen on for João Cancelo at 60'
tactical_change.effect: Atlético went from 7 shots and 1.37 xG before the break to 2 shots and 0.15 xG after it, with none on target; Barcelona's output stayed level (9 shots, 0.84 xG then 10 shots, 0.78 xG) and the winner came in the 66th minute. This is the second-half shift, not a proven formation change.
tactical_change.confidence: medium (the sub is confirmed by ESPN and BBC, but neither source says the shape changed or why Atlético faded)

best_player.name: Fermín López
best_player.why: Scored the equaliser on the stroke of half-time (45') and the winner (66'); most shots and the highest xG on the pitch.
best_player.source: https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401882816/barcelona-atletico-madrid Match Leaders (research/scrape_c8eaa32ec14b.json); goals and minutes from the same page and BBC report https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cm4g1jlw7vqlt

worst_player.name: Julián Álvarez
worst_player.why: Scout's pick: led Atlético in shots but had one on target and no goal; two of his four shots came after half-time and neither hit the target. He played the full 90 (not in the substitutions list).
worst_player.source: https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401882816/barcelona-atletico-madrid Match Leaders and Substitutions; shot minutes from shots_espn.json

surprise_stat.label: Atlético's last shot on target
surprise_stat.context: Their only goal came in the 10th minute; after Baena's save-forcing shot at 38' they had two more shots (55', 71') and none reached the keeper.

banter_material.fact: Atlético had 1.37 xG and 7 shots in the first half, then 0.15 xG and 2 shots in the second, none on target.
Atlético had 37% possession and 391 passes at home; Barcelona had 63% and 675 passes.
banter_material.source: BBC Basic Stats https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cm4g1jlw7vqlt; ESPN team stats https://www.espn.com/soccer/team-stats/_/gameId/401882816

banter_material.fact: Atlético's last shot on target was in the 38th minute, with 52 minutes of regulation play to go.
Atlético are now five points behind Barcelona (28 v 33) after being third and two points back before kick-off; BBC report: the loss was their second in the league.
banter_material.source: BBC report and La Liga table https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cm4g1jlw7vqlt

banter_material.fact: Points gained from a losing position this season: Barcelona 9, Atlético 1.

caveats: No player ratings on the web path: best/worst are Scout's pick from ESPN Match Leaders and the shot map.

Team xG is the sum of per-shot xG in the ESPN shot map (28 shots, matches the 9+19 team totals); ESPN's own player xG for López (0.92) and Álvarez (0.24) is used for the player cards, and differs by 0.01 from the sums.
ESPN says de Jong came on at 45', BBC at 46': use 'at half-time'. Neither source states a formation change after the sub, so the tactical beat is the second-half shift (confidence medium).
ESPN lists Oblak with 5 shots on target against while both sources give Barcelona 4 shots on target: no goalkeeper stats used.
BBC 'points from a losing position' may or may not include this match.
The pre-match tribute and the Atlético tifo (off-pitch) are not used.
